overviewParagraphs: Located just 20 kilometers from the heart of Phnom Penh, Vattanac Golf Resort is redefining luxury golf in Cambodia. The resort features two 18-hole championship courses, both crafted by the legendary six-time Major winner, Sir Nick Faldo.

The East Course is a strategic masterpiece, stretching to over 7,400 yards. It's defined by extensive water features, dramatic bunkering, and the inclusion of stunning scale models of pre-Angkorian architectural ruins, such as Preah Vihear and Angkor Wat, seamlessly integrated into the layout. The West Course, slightly shorter but no less challenging, offers narrower fairways and a more parkland-style feel, presenting a distinct contrast to the East.

Both courses are maintained to impeccable standards with pure Paspalum grass. Supported by a spectacular, state-of-the-art clubhouse and elite practice facilities, Vattanac Golf Resort has quickly established itself as the premier golfing destination in Cambodia's capital.

curatorBriefHtml: Vattanac Golf Resort is Cambodia’s flagship 36-hole luxury golf destination — two Sir Nick Faldo championship courses set 30 minutes east of central Phnom Penh. Together, the public-accessible East Course (famous for its illuminated Khmer temple replicas and full floodlit night golf) and the private, tighter West Course deliver Southeast Asia’s most polished capital-city golf complex, backed by a grand clubhouse and Troon-caliber turf maintenance.

Having played both Vattanac courses personally, I strongly recommend dedicating two full rounds here on any Phnom Penh stay — playing the iconic East Course (ideally twilight into night golf) and the members-style West Course the following morning. See our detailed loop breakdown in Vattanac East vs. West Courses.
Vattanac Golf Resort anchors the Phnom Penh leg of The Khmer Kingdom Links, paired with 5-star riverside luxury at Rosewood Phnom Penh or Raffles Hotel Le Royal.

scorecard.verdict: A 36-hole statement of grandeur by Sir Nick Faldo. Features scale replicas of historic Khmer landmarks and incorporates state-of-the-art night golf across two world-class championship layouts.

faqs.q: Should we play both the East and West courses at Vattanac Golf Resort?
faqs.a: Yes — they offer distinct personalities. The East Course delivers dramatic Khmer temple replicas, wide risk-reward corridors, and floodlit night golf, while the private West Course offers tighter, quieter positional golf.

faqs.q: How far is Vattanac Golf Resort from Phnom Penh luxury hotels?
faqs.a: About 30 to 40 minutes east of Rosewood Phnom Penh and Raffles Hotel Le Royal via private touring vehicle.

faqs.q: Can AGS combine Phnom Penh golf at Vattanac with Siem Reap and Angkor Wat?
faqs.a: Yes — a quick 50-minute domestic flight connects Phnom Penh and Siem Reap, letting you pair Vattanac’s 36 Faldo holes with Angkor Golf Resort and Angkor Wat in one 7-day tour.

faqs.q: What is the best time of year to visit Vattanac Golf Resort?
faqs.a: November through March is Cambodia’s dry high season with sunny skies and comfortable morning temperatures.
